title: Stabilize memory across linked worktrees
body: Resolve harness friction #47 by keeping repository identity/name stable across linked worktrees, preserving remembered insights during indexing, and creating queryable file nodes for source files.

log.text: Implementing stable linked-worktree identity, insight preservation, and source file graph nodes.

Shared memory state through the primary worktree, stabilized repository identity/name, indexed source file nodes, and added linked-worktree regression coverage. GroguCliTests pass; full CLI suite retains the pre-existing Seaglass stderr-order failure.
